svg.title: What do the hooks do around the agent's work?

g.text: What do the hooks do around the agent's work?
Claude Code and Codex: after a compaction or resume
[a gate bypass, any push or publish
(git push, gh pr create, gh release
create and the like, every tool)]
Claude Code: after a shell command fails
on a C or C++ file
Claude Code and Codex: when the agent ends its turn
newer than the log or not in it]
